landing.heroTitle: More than a trip. A reason to go.
landing.heroBody: Limited departures built around one reason to go: learn something, reset, chase an adventure, or show up for a night worth building a trip around. Each experience has its own dates, program and group — curated by WEEMAP, sometimes with people we trust.
landing.upcomingSubtitle: Pick the reason. We'll shape the trip around it.
landing.comingBody: New experiences are added when the timing, people and experience are right — not just to fill a calendar.
landing.customTitle: Got your own group in mind?
landing.customBody: We can shape a private experience around your group, goal or occasion.
